title: Loadout: Context Kits for Claude, Cursor, Copilot & More
description:
Loadout lets you create reusable context kits for your AI coding agents. It auto-detects your project stack and injects the right instructions into Claude, Codex, Cursor, opencode, and Copilot — in the CLI and VS Code.
